name: Sound
lead: Plays and stops sounds for everyone in a room: the `sound` global, or `room.sound`.

functions.name: play
functions.signature: sound.play(name: string, opts: { at: Vec3 ?, volume: number ?, pitch: number ?, category: string ?, }?)
functions.description: Plays a sound by name to everyone in the room; volume above 1 carries further, pitch 0.5..2.0.

functions.name: stop
functions.description: One sound by name, or every sound, for everyone in the room; 1.13+.

functions.name: stream
functions.signature: sound.stream(opts: { url: string ?, file: string ?, at: (SoundSpeaker | { SoundSpeaker })?, to: (Player | { Player })?, distance: number ?, loop: boolean ?, name: string ?, }) → SoundStream
functions.description: A live stream (MP3, or an FLV's sound) or a pack's sound file (OGG, MP3, WAV), heard through the mod a screen's stream uses. With `at`, from speakers: each player hears every speaker within `distance`. Without, from no place, at one volume. `to`: only these players. `loop`: files only.

title: sound global · type Sound
